name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Experience & SaaS Onboarding
summary: Customer experience and onboarding professional with 15+ years in SaaS, managing customer portfolios from onboarding and training through adoption, value realization, and retention. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner reseller network at Birdeye by tracking customer health and utilization and stepping in on adoption gaps before they became churn. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix (110% of implementation targets) and led a team of up to 20 onboarding specialists. Builds automated workflows and KPI dashboards that make customer health visible and keep follow-up consistent.

Build dashboards in Power BI and GA4 tracking engagement, funnel progression, and ROI, and report results with clear recommendations.
